Sandbox_TheCatalogue_PriceMultiplier_too: Scales every buy price, and defaults to 5. Sell prices follow automatically, since they are derived from the buy price.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_SellRatio_tooltip: Fraction of an item's value paid out when selling. 0.10 means the catalogue pays a tenth of what it charges. With the per-category rates on, the most wanted categories are paid at two and a half times this, so selling becomes lossless at 0.40 rather than at 1.0 -- and past that, any craft that adds value is an infinite money loop.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_MaxQuantityPerPurch: Upper bound on the quantity field in the buy panel.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_SellContainerConten: When on, selling a bag or a loaded gun sells what is inside it too, at its own value. When off, the catalogue refuses non-empty containers.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_DeliveryHoursMultip: Multiplier on how long an order takes. Lead time is mostly about bulk, and bulk compounds: a single pistol round is about twenty minutes, a hundred of them about two and a half hours, a crate of supplies most of a morning, a generator several days. Set very low for near-instant delivery.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_RushFeePercent_tool: Percentage added to an order that skips the wait and arrives immediately.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_DebugLogging_toolti: Writes timing and loot-table detail to the console. Off by default. Real problems -- refused purchases, refunds, API misuse -- are always logged regardless of this setting.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_OrderSeconds_toolti: How long the character spends filling in an order before it completes, as an interruptible action. Set to 0 for instant purchases.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_CatalogueLootMultip: How common the Catalogue is in world loot -- post offices, desks, magazine racks. Set to 0 to remove it from loot and leave crafting as the only route.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_RequireCatalogueOnP: When on, the catalogue window closes if you no longer have a Catalogue in your inventory or a bag. Turn it off for an arcade-style game where the catalogue is a menu rather than an object you carry.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_SpendFromContainers: When on, the catalogue pays out of any container the character can reach -- a crate, a counter, a car boot -- and not only out of their own pockets. The reach rule is the game's own: the containers your loot window is showing you are the containers the catalogue can see. Turn it off to make the weight of cash a real ceiling on a single purchase again.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_CategorySellRates: Pay more for what is wanted
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_CategorySellRates_t: When on, the company pays roughly 25 percent for weapons, ammunition, medicine, tools and radios, the ordinary rate for most things, and about 5 percent for ornaments, mementoes and improvised clubs. These are multipliers on the sell ratio, so that dial still scales everything together. Off pays one rate for everything.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_AcceptPerishableFoo: When OFF, the default, the catalogue refuses to buy fresh produce, meat and caught fish, while still selling them to you. Tins and sacks are unaffected. Farming, fishing and foraging each produce dozens of items a trip, nearly all at the one-dollar floor, at no risk and without end. Turn it on if you would rather the catalogue bought your harvest.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_StockLimitMultiplie: Scales how many of the dearer items the company can supply per week. At 1.0 that is one generator, three pistols or ten crowbars; 2.0 doubles every band, and 0 removes the limits entirely. Anything under about 250 dollars on the shelf is never limited, so ammunition, food and materials are unaffected.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_MinConditionToSell_: Items below this fraction of condition are refused. 0.0 accepts anything, including near-broken gear and rotten food.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_BankingEnabled_tool: Accounts, credit cards, cash machines and the computer. Off returns the mod to buying and selling with the notes in your pocket, and no credit card in the world is touched -- which is also the way out if another mod cares about CreditCard.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_ForeignCards_toolti: Gives every credit card the world spawns an owner, a balance and a PIN you have to work out. Off leaves your OWN account working and stops the mod naming or stamping cards it finds.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_ForeignBalanceMulti: Scales what is in a card found in the world. The underlying spread is weighted -- half are petty cash, about one in twenty is worth the walk -- and this moves the level without flattening that shape. 0 makes every found card empty.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_PinTries_tooltip: How many wrong PINs a card takes before it is refused. The Burglar trait always gets two more than this.
Sandbox_TheCatalogue_PinLockoutHours_too: How long a card stays refused afterwards, in game hours. Lower it if working through the arrangements a pencil impression leaves you is too slow; 0 removes the lockout and keeps only the count.
